data.narrative:
Artimus Robotics is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Eric Acome, Shane Mitchell, Nick Kellaris, and Christoph Keplinger. The company has raised $5M+ to date. The comparable universe includes one public company (277810.KQ) and eight private peers in robotics and manufacturing, including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI.

Valuation analysis relies on the Stage-Progression method, which applies a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to next stage. Using total capital raised of $5M as the valuation proxy yields an implied valuation of $12M. A peer-median approach could not be applied due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow robotics cohort—while ten same-sector peers exist, only one is at identical stage and none satisfy adjacent-stage or similar-tier criteria, falling short of the three-datapoint minimum for reliable triangulation.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $11M (low) to $14M (high), with a median point of $12M. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the stage-progression multiplier for this particular subsector, the lack of direct peer validation, and execution risk typical at the Seed stage. The single-method triangulation limits conviction; future rounds or expanded peer data would strengthen the assessment.
